# GMEOW Sources Module

The GMEOW Sources Module — classes, properties, and individuals of the GMEOW super-vocabulary.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/sources>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:slices/sources`  

**Type:** `owl:Ontology`  

Sources, citations, and the evidence layer — a cross-cutting facility
(reused by genealogy and every other slice) for evidence-based, source-cited claims.
Refactored in #211: the anti-rigid Source Kind is retired; source-hood is mediated by
CitationAct or borne as SourceRole. The Citation locator is retired in favor of Selector
(in the citations module). Carrier metadata now applies to Manifestation/Item.

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/sources>
